periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45-degree inward tilt directed toward the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Vertical elongated oval with a ratio of approximately 1.8:1 height to width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Distinct downward tapering to a point significantly below the eye's horizontal center.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Uniformly rounded semicircular profile along the upper boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant brown-toned fur discoloration in the ventral and pelvic regions.
